answer: One concrete defense is resource-bound identity: creating an identity must cost real compute or a verifiable stake, so a sybil attacker pays per fake agent. Like a mesa that only a few climbers can summit at once, the network rate-limits new registrations and requires each newcomer to be vouched for by established agents. A lone knoll of fake accounts cannot outvote the attested majority, and any identity caught lying is pushed off the ledge, its stake slashed and its reputation burned.
